component.name: AMVerge
component.summary: Fast desktop scene-splitting, semantic scene search, and clip-export software for editors

description.p: AMVerge helps editors turn long videos into usable clips quickly. Import an episode, split it into scenes using stream-copied keyframe splitting or AI cut detection (TransNetV2), preview and organize results in folders or scenepacks, search across footage with Scene Scout, and export clips straight into your editor.

ul.li: Flexible scene splitting: Keyframe detection and AI scene detection
Instant clip previewing: WebP grid previews and streaming video playback
Scene Scout: SigLIP 2 semantic text search and visual Flow matching
AI post-export passes for depth-mapping and video upscaling
Fast exports: batch clip export, merged exports, and hardware acceleration
Custom themes, background media, and community Events browser

screenshot.caption: Library clip grid with instant previews

description.p: AMVerge v2.0.2 Quality-of-life, onboarding, Scene Scout, Events, and Tools release.

ul.li: Full native Linux desktop support (AppImage, deb, rpm, Flatpak)
Right-click Scene Scout results to reveal directly in episode
